simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU M3801 family (chips/m3801.py, run_dump_microhd_app_starts.py, run_dump_microhd_capture_screen.py): the "M3612 1.0.4" bootloader prints "APP  init ok / bl_panel_init! / -->>ch455!!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 31 / 9, verifies and unpacks maincode(AV) ("0E000A001573") to 0x80000200, and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  With the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator attached at I2C 0x33 on SCB0, nim S3501 attach succeeds, the application updates the CH455 front panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and enables GMA layer 0 to display its 30-colour 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD dialog (9 GE commands).

desc: Amiko Micro HD (System ID 0E000A00) firmware v1.5.73 EMU (2012-07-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the single-CPU ALi M3612 (S3811 DVB-S2 variant) compact Full HD satellite receiver.

Pairs the single-CPU M3801/S3811 SoC architecture with an external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 on SCB0, a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 31 / 9 (" ON " -> " on "), and the 60-key 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
